all.stdout:
/omni:operator-ruling arguments:
<ask|ruling|consent|hold|release> --lane <lane> [record.sh flags]  (or --kind <that word>)
---
<the operator's words, verbatim; ruling and consent only>
  flags as record.sh takes them: ask --ticket --question --options --recommend;
  ruling --question Q --ticket (--mechanism PATH | --mechanism-ticket OMN-n | --kind decision)
         [--amends S] [--supersedes S] [--unrelated S] [--re ID] [--note] [--join-lines]
         [--relay-to L --relay-text T]; every open ruling on --ticket is named once as
         --amends (it changes it), --supersedes (it replaces it) or --unrelated (a different
         matter under the same ticket; that ruling stays in force), or it is refused;
  consent --approved '<a; b>' --out-of-scope '<c; d>' [--amends <earlier consent stamp>] [--away]
         [--approved-by X] [--join-lines]  (both scope lists are header flags, never the body);
  hold --to L|--repo R|--pr N with --until/--after/--proof; release --re <hold id>.
  --lane may be left out when --session-env names a session.env that sets SESSION_LANE.

/omni:ledger-write arguments:
<TYPE> --lane <lane> [onex-ledger row flags]
---
<the row's free text: one line, no pipe>
  TYPE: CLAIM STATUS TERMINAL FRICTION CORRECTION MSG ACK HOLD RELEASE
  (RULING and OPERATOR-CONSENT go through /omni:operator-ruling, which keeps the words
  verbatim and adds the OUT OF SCOPE floor).
  e.g. CLAIM --lane L --ticket OMN-n --actor A --model M --est-hours 2 --displaces X
       TERMINAL --lane L --friction none --outcome done --closes-claim <claim stamp>
or: append-rows, then --- and the pre-built rows, one per line.

or: inbox <lane[,lane...]> [--limit N]
